## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat: …`, `fix: …`)
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass locally
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by tests
- [ ] Documentation is updated if needed (`docs/`, `.env.example`)
- [ ] Visual changes reuse existing components and design tokens
